title: Cache canonical records in the server, invalidated by the file fingerprint
description: Every /api/tree, /api/search and /api/tickets/:id/plan request re-reads all canonical files (6,063 tickets with 2 KB descriptions: tree page ~0.45 s, search ~1 s, plan ~1.3 s). Keep an in-memory snapshot of tickets, relationships, comments, documents and design records in pman serve, keyed by the per-area fingerprint from /api/version (size+mtime), so unchanged areas are served from memory. Writes through the server update or invalidate the snapshot. Files stay the source of truth; no on-disk index. Measure before/after with bench/scale.mjs and the 6k synthetic project.
